translations.web: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
translations.bsb: Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
translations.kjv: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
translations.asv: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
